description: Test whether static cavity volume predicts substrate size class across hydrolases with known substrates, and compare active-site rim lipophilicity
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, pearsonr
df=pd.read_csv('fsh3_pocket_comparison.csv')
k=df.dropna(subset=['substrate_heavy_atoms']).copy()
k['pocket_vol_A3']=k['pocket_vol_A3'].astype(float); k['tunnel_A']=k['tunnel_A'].astype(float)
kk=k.dropna(subset=['pocket_vol_A3'])
rho,p=spearmanr(kk['substrate_heavy_atoms'],kk['pocket_vol_A3'])
rho2,p2=spearmanr(kk['substrate_heavy_atoms'],kk['tunnel_A'])
print(f"n={len(kk)} enzymes with known substrate")
print(f"Spearman substrate size vs apo pocket volume : rho={rho:+.2f}, p={p:.3f}")
print(f"Spearman substrate size vs tunnel length     : rho={rho2:+.2f}, p={p2:.3f}")
print("TLL 1DT3 (triacylglycerol, largest substrate): NO pocket detectable at the nucleophile (closed lid).")
fsh3=float(df.loc[df.structure.str.startswith('FSH3'),'pocket_vol_A3'].iloc[0])
ovca2=float(df.loc[df.structure.str.startswith('OVCA2'),'pocket_vol_A3'].iloc[0])
fsh1=float(df.loc[df.structure.str.startswith('FSH1'),'pocket_vol_A3'].iloc[0])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
ax=axes[0]
cols={'S-formylglutathione':'#4c78a8','pimeloyl methyl ester':'#4c78a8','palmitoyl thioester / lyso-PC acyl':'#f58518',
      'palmitoyl thioester':'#f58518','2-arachidonoylglycerol':'#e45756','1,2-diacyl-PC':'#72b7b2','triacylglycerol':'#72b7b2'}
for _,r in kk.iterrows():
    ax.scatter(r['substrate_heavy_atoms'],r['pocket_vol_A3'],s=90,color=cols.get(r['substrate'],'grey'),zorder=3)
    ax.annotate(r['structure'].split()[0],(r['substrate_heavy_atoms'],r['pocket_vol_A3']),
                textcoords='offset points',xytext=(6,5),fontsize=9)
ax.scatter([55],[150],marker='x',color='#72b7b2',s=90); ax.annotate('TLL (no pocket found)',(55,150),xytext=(-95,-14),textcoords='offset points',fontsize=9,color='#72b7b2')
ax.axhline(fsh3,color='#c53030',ls='--',lw=1.4); ax.text(14,fsh3+90,'FSH3 (AlphaFold) = %d $\\AA^3$'%fsh3,color='#c53030',fontsize=10)
ax.axhline(ovca2,color='#9467bd',ls=':',lw=1.2); ax.text(14,ovca2+90,'OVCA2 (AlphaFold) = %d $\\AA^3$'%ovca2,color='#9467bd',fontsize=9)
ax.axhline(fsh1,color='#8c564b',ls=':',lw=1.2); ax.text(14,fsh1+90,'FSH1 (AlphaFold) = %d $\\AA^3$'%fsh1,color='#8c564b',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('heavy atoms in the physiological substrate'); ax.set_ylabel('cavity volume at the nucleophile ($\\AA^3$)')
ax.set_title('Apo cavity volume does not track substrate size\nSpearman rho=%+.2f, p=%.2f (n=%d)'%(rho,p,len(kk)),fontsize=11)
ax=axes[1]
order=df.sort_values('rim_frac_apolar')
ax.barh(order['structure'],order['rim_frac_apolar'],color=['#c53030' if s.startswith('FSH3') else '#9ecae1' for s in order['structure']])
ax.set_xlabel('apolar fraction of exposed surface within 16 $\\AA$ of the nucleophile')
ax.set_title('Interfacial character of the active-site rim',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
